sequence: The configuration fix enabled the feature, but the first real provider attempts exposed two production dependency controls that had never been exercised by this workflow.

apiBody.message: Too many requests. Please try again later.

aclDryRunBeforeFix.command: ACL DRYRUN shopixy-api-runtime EVAL <script> 4 ai:ratelimit:<tenant>:minute ai:ratelimit:<tenant>:hour ai:ratelimit:<tenant>:day ai:ratelimit:<tenant>:month
aclDryRunBeforeFix.result: User shopixy-api-runtime has no permissions to access the 'ai:ratelimit:<tenant>:minute' key

redisRuntimeAcl.fix: Added the two exact key patterns to the shopixy-api-runtime ACL and rolled the Redis StatefulSets one at a time so the ACL file was reloaded.

openRouterEgress.browserBody: Cloudflare 502 origin_bad_gateway from the admin edge; the origin API had returned 502 after the proxy rejected the provider connection.
